verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance says registered-agent documents are received electronically. The public OpenAPI spec includes registered-agent-deliveries endpoints, which suggests received deliveries can be retrieved later from the account rather than only seen at notification time. Nothing documents how long they are kept or how archived notices are browsed or searched. missing for 10: documented retention period or archive of received notices, explicit in-account retrieval of past deliveries months later, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, received documents stay archived in the account so a notice can be retrieved months later, not just at notification time
